bondPowers.name: Eyes of the Void
bondPowers.description: You can see perfectly well in even pitch darkness, fog, or poor weather conditions. Gain +1 Accuracy and increased effect on checks that rely on surveying or observing your surroundings. You can see even fine detail up to a mile away unaided.

bondPowers.name: Plunder the Void
bondPowers.description: When you strike out alone and enter a dark and distant place, nobody â€“ PC or NPC â€“ can find you and you may ask the GM one question about a situation at hand. They must answer truthfully with â€œyesâ€, â€œnoâ€, or â€œunclearâ€. Whether this is merely a mental space or a different realm entirely is up to you and your GM. You return to reality where you left it at the start of the next scene.

bondPowers.name: Heartsight
bondPowers.description: By concentrating momentarily you can sense the ambient emotional state of those close to you. You donâ€™t have to be able to see them, but the effect becomes muddled if there are more than a few people close by. Get +1 Accuracy and increased effect on your next check acting on any insight you glean from this.

bondPowers.name: Possession
bondPowers.description: Ask a dark presence deep inside of you for advice on a course of action. The GM answers and you get either +1 Accuracy or increased effect on your next action following this advice (GM choice).

bondPowers.name: Blood Scent
bondPowers.description: If someone or something is bleeding, gain +1 Accuracy and increased effect on any action made to intimidate, track, or harm them

Woven from incredibly strong nanocarbon and arachnosynth threading, reinforced grapple line is carried on waist-mounted spools and attached to charge-actuated brachial projectors. weapon.flavorDescription: A simple tactical-scale version of a logging tool, IPS-Nâ€™s chain axe is a serrated chainblade run off core power. The axeâ€™s teeth are tungsten-tipped, hardened to chew through both hard and soft targets. Chain axes are effective weapons and utility tools that are often used by boarding parties to breach reinforced bulkheads.

Much like GMS mechs, GMS weapons are reliable galactic standards, made using interchangeable parts and built to withstand almost any conditions. There are three lines currently in production.
The Type-III (T-3) line is made up of heavy weapons, ordnance, and other exotic, specialized, or massive weapons. A broad classification, the T-3 range includes conventional-kinetic anti-materiel rifles, super-rapid cycling pulse rifles, missile racks, cannons, and drone nexuses â€“ â€œhiveâ€style launchers that serve as miniature factory, hangar, and deployment systems for portable drones. The classification also includes the fearsome â€œsegment knifeâ€, a system that uses flash-printing to produce disposable edged weapons in a vicinity around the user.
